data.description: cutting edge fabrication (cef) is an iso 9001:2015 certified metal fabrication company specializing in welding medium to large metal structures and components. the company has been conducting business since 1990 in milwaukee, wi. cef fabrication services include welding, metal forming, metal bending, plate cutting, laser cutting, plasma cutting, oxy-fuel cutting, sheering, production sawing, cnc machining, and final assembly. cef fabrication capabilities include processing raw material to finished product fabrications, state-of-the-art laser plate cutting, high-performance production sawing, precision cnc machining, full assembly services, and quality inspection. cutting edge fabrication’s high-level of customer satisfaction results from providing the highest-quality metal fabrication products and services available. we continuously strive to excel in all manufacturing processes utilizing the best quality standards, ongoing workforce training and well-maintained production equipment. our dedication to quality is absolute and without compromise as we focus on delivering 100% customer satisfaction.

data.description: jk welding is a full service welding company offering custom fabrication, welding and metal repair to clients in houston, san antonio, austin, dallas, and the surrounding areas. our professional welding fabricators provide superior service in our welding shop and field service. our section iv, aws or dnv certified welders are committed to the highest standard of quality workmanship and have the attention to detail needed to ensure your satisfaction. our experienced welding fabricators, metal workers, and professional shop artists are highly trained, knowledgeable, and experienced at their craft. we have decades of experience and technical skill to handle any custom fabrication job for all commercial and industrial applications, including complete design, installation, and repair services.

data.name: MacDonald Steel
data.description: macdonald steel, founded in 1957, is a custom steel fabrication and machining plant. our facility sits on 20 acres of land and the plant floor consists of 190 000 sq ft of fabrication space. macdonald steel includes three divisions; custom fabricating, environmental systems division and specialty products. the custom fabrication side of our business manufactures products to our customers’ drawings and specifications. we manufacture parts weighing only a few pounds to items that require special permitting to ship due to size or weight. our facility provides one stop shopping for our customers. environmental systems division designs, manufactures, installs and services our own dust collectors (shaker, reverse air, pulse), cyclones, rotary air locks, fans, spark systems and bin covers. our 50 years of experience is leveraged to offer our customers an exceptional line of products to suit their application. the specialty products division combines the disciplines of design, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of brew-on-the premise systems and equipment. our brew-on premise equipment packages are built to the highest standard in the industry. macdonald steel personnel and welding procedures are certified to csa w47.1 in the fusion welding of steel products. we have earned american society for mechanical engineers certification as well as ontario technical standards and safety act certification in pressure vessel manufacturing and repairs.

data.description: dimar is conveniently located in clarence, ny, minutes from buffalo and a short drive from ontario, canada. we have full manufacturing capabilities and state-of-the-art machinery that provides maximum efficiency. quality is what dimar strives for, it is achieved through the hard work of our highly skilled employees. dimar has another plant which is close by in cheektowaga, ny. plant #2 features thick gauge, heavy fabricating capability with high bays and overhead cranes. it also features skilled metal fabricating craftsmen who produce large custom fabrications weighing as much as 20,000 pounds each. dimar manufacturing corporation is committed to exceeding customer requirements and increasing customer satisfaction through continual improvements of our processes, services, and our quality management system. the focus of our quality management system is on error prevention and continuous process improvement in all areas of our business. through an ongoing effort to educate our employees and suppliers toward a culture of quality, employing technological advancements, and continued procurement of state-of-the-art equipment, dimar will achieve it's goal of exceeding customer expectations. in order to provide this level of consistent quality and dedication to our customer, dimar maintains a quality management system in accordance with the requirements of iso 9000:2008. our wonderful staff makes dimar a company that people want to work with and work for! visit us in person or check out our company website to request a quote for your business or find out about the latest employment opportunities!!

data.name: Bens Machines
data.description: ben machine is a fully integrated advanced manufacturing facility offering sophisticated 3, 4 and 5 axis cnc milling, cnc turning, precision sheet metal fabrication, welding, assembly and finishing services for the military, defense, aerospace, and high tech commercial industries. ben machine is registered under the controlled goods program (cgp) and fully compliant with international trade in arms regulations (itar). our quality system is certified to as9100 and iso 9001 standards and we are active members of the ontario aerospace council and the canadian association of defence and security industries. ben machine was founded in 1973 as a small tool and die shop for the investment casting industry. since its founding, ben machine has remained an industry leader, expanding into cnc machining, turning, and sheet metal operations. we specialize in defence, aerospace, medical, and nuclear solutions. we meet cgp, itar, and as9100 standards. today, we are a fully integrated solutions provider that uses the latest manufacturing technology to provide our customers with complete quality precision parts, faster lead times, and competitive pricing. as we continue to grow, we are steadily upgrading our technological capabilities and broadening our services to provide a one-stop-shop for all of your sub-contracting needs. think of ben machine as an extension of your company. we have invested millions of dollars into our current plant and equipment, and we continue to grow. housed in over 120,000 square feet over 2 facilities, we offer all services under on site. with significant room to expand, we can easily double our capacity overnight. our team of experts includes more than 210 highly skilled tradespeople, engineers, management, and support staff to see your projects from inception to completion. and as a division of exchange income corporation, we can leverage our sister companies, pal aerospace and deca aviation, to add even more value.

data.description: wesgar is the fastest growing custom precision sheet metal fabricator and the largest producer of high-mix, low-volume products in western canada and the pacific northwest. a specialist in identifying and solving the unique challenges and complex needs of each customer, wesgar crafts tailored solutions, such as managing spikes and variable demand, reducing cycle times, managing compound quality and technical requirements, lowering costs, and mitigating supply chain disruptions—allowing our customers to meet and deliver to their customers’ exacting standards. our world-class, 100,000 square feet plant, located on wesgar’s four-acre campus, boasts $30 million in state-of-the-art sheet metal and copper fabrication equipment. wesgar's unrivaled range of services, intended to eliminate obstacles to success, include design for manufacturability, prototype production, fabrication, finishing, assembly, machining, stringent quality inspection and documentation, inventory and stocking programs, and logistical services. wesgar’s one-stop shop satisfies the industry’s high demands. our more than 200 fabrication experts, engineers, metal technologists, and quality control professionals work around the clock as a cohesive team to precisely oversee the dependable delivery of thousands of precision items manufactured in light gauge steel, aluminum, stainless steel, and copper. energy storage and backup power systems, power distribution, oems, commercial electronics, telecommunications, medical, industrial and automation, clean and renewable energy, security, recreation, and other industries are among those we serve. wesgar values long-term customer relationships and is proud to count enersys, rockwell automation, ballard power, kodak, thermo fisher scientific, and honeywell as customers who rely on us to deliver unrivaled responsiveness, responsiveness, collaborative engineering, innovative and accurate precision fabrication, and a flexible approach.
